prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. A corrected individual ARC Daily Card Cabinet CYBERPUNK GPU-ENGINEER portrait, matching the established Jean-François Puget / Dries illustrated character family. This is the modern cyberpunk treatment, NOT the retro pulp conversion. Input1 is THIS PERSON's own photograph and is the ONLY facial identity source. Input2 is Puget's established illustrated card for the integrated face machinery, huge GPU equipment, hand-rendered facial planes and coherent illustration language ONLY. Never borrow Puget's facial features, age, beard, hair or costume verbatim. Ignore all writing, branding, historic scores, ranks and labels in reference2.
Preserve the exact source person's facial structure, age, skin tone, hair, facial hair and characteristic expression. REPAINT the face in the same richly detailed cinematic comic/painterly medium as the headgear, neck and body. Fine inked contours and painted skin planes; no isolated photographic face on an illustration, no pasted-on head, no anime, no uncanny smoothing or generic superhero face. Facial cybernetics are substantial, anatomically fitted and visibly bolted together: optical unit at the brow/eye, ear receiver/temple frame, cheek communications hardware, hinged lower jaw or collar supports, cables entering suit/compute rig. Keep enough natural face visible for recognition. Strong structural integration of head, neck, shoulders and actual compute hardware. Equipment, coolants and powers are editorial fantasy, no claim about real methods or budget.
A striking varied oversize graphics-card rig with clearly identifiable cooling fans, exposed PCB edges, heat sinks, copper coolant pipes, plugs and tiny multicolored ARC square-grid screens; no generic jeweled fantasy armor. Rich tactile black/metal/fabric materials, cinematic cyan/amber rim lighting, grand ARC scoring-hall environment. Head-to-waist glamour portrait, face near upper third. Keep whole headgear, hands and essential props inside frame. Full bleed portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100, calmer darker lower quarter for code-added card stats later. NO text, logos, digits, names, ranks, medals, title, watermark, border or frame. One person only. No retro halftone paper or pulp space suit; maintain the previously established cyberpunk illustration family. Preserve Mykyta's tousled light-brown hair, full distinctive GINGER BEARD, light eyes, straight nose and thoughtful expression. His beard remains visible. Unique open mechanical headband with teal circuit-board brow piece, round cyan microscope monocle on an adjustable bracket, copper ear cup and two wired cheek clamps flanking the beard, neck receiver beneath beard rather than covering it. Deep cyan/emerald work jacket and brushed brass exoskeleton; one big cylindrical GPU radiator behind shoulder, a clear coolant reservoir with illuminated square test tiles, oversized graphics-card board held diagonally by one mechanical glove. Facial skin and beard receive the same ink/paint detailing as metal; never photographic skin floating above armor. Friendly ingenious engineer presence, no borrowed dark Puget beard.
